application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief
application.note: The release holds two NMC passenger cars (vehicle45, vehicle69) and one LFP bus (LFP01): https://doi.org/10.1038/s41560-026-02131-5, SI Supplementary Table 1 p. 16, and TotalCells 95 / 156 (measured).

units_released.note: Rule: one row per vin. Measured in scripts/facts/_extra.py.

cells_liion.source: one cell per released cell-voltage channel (TotalCells per vin)

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Maximum TotalCells per vin; CellVoltages carries one value per cell.

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41560-026-02131-5, SI Note 1 p. 5 and Supplementary Table 1 p. 16
energy_mwh.note: Nominal pack energies 52 kWh (NMC car, 1P95S, two cars) and 105 kWh (LFP bus, 1P156S). Coulomb counting on the data gives LFP01 108.9 kWh (median of 1405 charges); vehicle45 46.8 kWh (median of 871 charges); vehicle69 47.5 kWh (median of 873 charges).

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used because calendar spans are measurable; the cadence is stated (nominal 0.1 Hz, paper p. 2).

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://1drv.ms/u/c/909aeacce295a32a/IQCsGxZgHovYTqJEXhfqRIIZAWASy12k6Urytil7VPa0LJY?e=ISLuvO; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
